subtitle: Party kart racing knockout
promo: Six wild worlds, 60 Tour stages and a collapsing hex arena. Drift, grab items and outlast everyone to win the crown!
description:
Grab the wheel and survive the chaos! ZOOMBLE is a party kart racer where every round knocks out the slowest drivers – until only one racer is crowned.

RACE, BUMP, SURVIVE
• Knockout matches over several rounds – finish high enough to qualify for the next one
• The final round decides who wears the crown
• Drift around corners to charge a boost and fly past rivals

SIX COLOURFUL WORLDS
Race through Sunny Meadows, Candy Canyon, Frosty Peaks, Dusty Dunes, Lava Rumble and Sunset Bay – each with its own tracks, hazards and obstacles.

ITEMS AND CHAOS
Turbo boosts, Zap Orbs, shields, goo traps and more. Use them at the right moment to turn the race around.

HEX ARENA SHOWDOWN
Keep moving on the collapsing hex floor – one wrong turn and you're out!

TOUR MODE
Clear 60 Tour stages, earn up to three stars on each and unlock new worlds.

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock karts with different handling (Buggy, Rocket, Hopper, Bumper), paint colours and fun hats – from a propeller cap to the Royal Crown.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Adjustable kart speed and camera distance
• Touch controls made for phones
• Play offline, anytime – rivals are computer-controlled

ZOOMBLE is free to play and supported by ads. Optional rewarded ads let you double your match coins or daily reward.
